page_title: ATA 2-2 UDI | Atalanta v Udinese 07/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Antonio Rapuano is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
90+4' Wow, what an escape. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
90+3' Lennon Miller (Udinese) dribbles his way into the box and has an effort on goal, but the ball flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
90+2' Lennon Miller (Udinese) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
90+1' The game is interrupted now, Lennon Miller (Udinese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' The foul by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) was seen by Antonio Rapuano who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
88' Substitution. Sead Kolasinac walks off the pitch and Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) comes on as a substitute.

87' Arthur Atta (Udinese) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
85' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) works the corner short.
85' Rough tackle by Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Udinese, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
84' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
80' Here comes a substitution. Juan Arizala (Udinese) is brought on as a substitute for Hassane Kamara.
79' 2 - 2 Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the left post, and thus alter the score to 2:2.

79' Maduka Okoye was forced into action to thwart Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.

78' Arthur Atta (Udinese) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
76' Substitution. Keinan Davis leaves the pitch and is replaced by Adam Buksa (Udinese).
75' 1 - 2 Goal! Nicola Zalewski swings the ball deep into the box and finds Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the roof of the net. 1:2.
74' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
69' A free kick into the box, taken by Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
68' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Atalanta have a free kick.
66' Maduka Okoye (Udinese) gets booked for the first time in this match.

66' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
65' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
64' Half-chance! Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) plays a pass into the box, but Maduka Okoye reacts well to snuff out the attack.
62' The game has come to an end for Jakub Piotrowski. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Lennon Miller (Udinese).
62' Kosta Runjaic has decided to substitute Nicolo Zaniolo and he is replaced by Arthur Atta (Udinese).
62' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
62' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
62' The ball is cleared after Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

59' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box finds Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta), whose header flies way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
57' Here is a change. Odilon Kossounou is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta).
57' Substitution. Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) in, Lazar Samardzic out.
57' Substitution. Raoul Bellanova makes way for Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta).
55' 0 - 2 Goal! Keinan Davis (Udinese) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:2.
55' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
53' Antonio Rapuano shows the yellow card to Marten de Roon (Atalanta) for a heavy challenge.
52' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
50' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the right post and flies out of play.
48' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

47' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. The referee blows his whistle, Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Yunus Musah (Atalanta) is replaced by Marten de Roon.
46' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Oier Zarraga comes on the pitch for Branimir Mlacic (Udinese).
46' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Atalanta force their opponents to concede a corner.
45+2' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
44' A lofted cross from Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
44' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
43' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Atalanta earn a corner.
43' Yunus Musah (Atalanta) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
40' 0 - 1 Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the left side of the goal. The score is 0:1.
39' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
38' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) launches a cross from the corner, but Maduka Okoye is alert to thwart the effort.
38' Surely that's handball by one of the Udinese players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

38' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball is out of play and Atalanta manage to earn a corner.

37' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team. Udinese win a free kick.

35' Atalanta are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
34' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese).

33' Antonio Rapuano interrupts the game. One of the players from Udinese won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. It's a free kick to Atalanta, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
31' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) commits a rough foul. Antonio Rapuano stops the game and makes a call. Atalanta have a free kick.
30' A player from Atalanta commits a rough challenge. Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick to Udinese.
29' The corner kick from Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
28' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marco Carnesecchi intercepts the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to Udinese.
28' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
27' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman makes the right call and Udinese will have a corner.
26' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Atalanta will take a free kick near the side line.
25' Isak Hien (Atalanta) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul. Udinese are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
24' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta).

23' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
23' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atalanta will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

23' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
21' Isak Hien (Atalanta) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul. Udinese are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
20' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
20' The foul by Branimir Mlacic (Udinese) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Antonio Rapuano.
20' Branimir Mlacic (Udinese) makes a slide tackle, but referee Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul. Free kick. Atalanta will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
20' Isak Hien (Atalanta) misses a complete sitter from the corner, heading the ball well wide of the left post from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
19' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) will take the corner.
19' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atalanta.
19' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
17' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but Maduka Okoye punches the ball away. Atalanta get a corner.

14' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
13' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

12' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
12' Isak Hien (Atalanta) makes a rough challenge and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul. Udinese have a free kick.

10' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
8' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) was too forceful with his tackle and Antonio Rapuano interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Atalanta in a dangerous position.

6' That was close by Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
5' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
4' Branimir Mlacic (Udinese) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! There is a free kick near the sideline to Atalanta.
3' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Udinese will have the kick-off.
Antonio Rapuano is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
